Hotels.Name: Spring Hotel Bitacora
Hotels.Description:
Kids will love the great range of activities at this bright, lively hotel, and parents will love the chance to relax and unwind at the poolside or by the sea.

From zipping down water slides to splashing around in pools, clambering around multicoloured climbing frames or pottering in the play area, there’s tons for kids to get up to at the Spring Hotel Bitácora. Teens can hang out at the youth club, which is kitted out with games consoles, pool tables and more. There’s also a packed activity programme run by the hotel, including lots of sports and craft workshops.

With all that going on, there’ll be time for grown ups to enjoy the poolside loungers, shaded by umbrellas and palm trees. Bedrooms are bright, spacious, modern and family-friendly. From the main restaurant to the vibrant bars, there are plenty of choices when it comes to food and drink. And, of course, the famous Playa De Las Americas is just outside. Its golden, sandy beaches, abundance of seaside activities (including dolphin-watching and trips on a pirate ship), cafés, bars and restaurants means there are options for everyone.

A family-focused resort in the heart of Playa De Las Americas, it will be easy to keep all ages entertained at this hotel, while still enjoying some downtime in the Tenerife sunshine.

Hotels.Name: Gala Tenerife Hotel
Hotels.Description:
Hotel Gala in Playa de Las Americas, Tenerife, offers families a location close to a comprehensive range of amenities. The sandy beach at Costa Adeje is just two minutes away, nightlife is local or if you prefer to stay poolside, offers swimming facilities and a splashpark for younger members of your party.

The hotel offers guests a revitalising spa with a sauna, Turkish bath and hot tub to totally unwind in. For the more active guests, the onsite gym helps you keep on top of your fitness.

Meanwhile, the onsite restaurant offers flavoursome cuisine for breakfast, lunch and dinner in the Kalahari restaurant. For an extra gastronomic delight, the show cooking adds excitement and the wow factor. Furthermore, with an impressive array of wines, sampling their stocks will be a wine lovers dream.

Outside the confines of the hotel, golden beaches with inviting translucent waters are just a few minutes away. For the evening, you’ll find a varied array of nightlife to suit all ages. With bars, clubs and restaurants populating the local area, you’ll be spoilt for choice.

With two freshwater pools and the children’s club this is a fantastic destination hotel for families to get away and enjoy the many facilities and services at the Hotel Gala, Playa de Las Americas.

Hotels.Name: Iberostar Las Dalias
Hotels.Description:
In a top location just minutes from two of the best beaches in southern Tenerife, the Iberostar Las Dalias is a lively and modern all-inclusive resort with superb facilities for families.

The hotel has a number of outdoor pools to cool off in, including a dedicated children’s one. The mini club also keeps kids busy with its extensive programme of activities – such as nature walks to learn about local wildlife – while adults can unwind with a relaxing massage or a spruce up at the beauty salon.

Rooms are light, bright and spacious, with elegant balconies that are great for soaking up some of the coast’s 300 days of sunshine. The hotel’s main buffet restaurant specialises in Canary Island cuisine, themed international dinners and spectacular show cooking, plus there are various bars for snacks and drinks, including one poolside serving ice cream.

The hotel sits at the heart of the vibrant Costa Adeje, a fantastic resort with designer boutiques, grand hotels and fine restaurants that make it a favourite with celebrities. Brilliant beaches lie all along the nearby coastline, including the famous Playa de las Americas and Playa de las Vistas.

A large and lively hotel in an ace corner of southwest Tenerife, the Las Dalias is an upscale but relaxed destination for a family holiday on the island’s sunniest coast.

Hotels.Name: H10 Las Palmeras
Hotels.Description:
The chic, colourful interiors of this four-star resort mark it out as an upscale choice in the very heart of the Playa de las Americas. Families will enjoy the daytime beach activities, making this hotel a great choice if you’re holidaying with the kids.

With large swimming pools surrounded by spacious subtropical gardens, there’s a sense of retreat even with the bustling town just outside. And you don’t have to break the spell – the central restaurant offers buffet meals, with two other à la carte options and a host of bars for drinks and cocktails. While adults enjoy the welcoming rooms and poolside lounging, there’s an array of kids’ clubs available to occupy the little ones, designed for various age groups but all offering educational games and supervised outdoor fun.

Because the hotel is so central, there's easy access to the Playa de las Americas and its water sports and boat trips, including whale- and dolphin-watching cruises that will be popular with the whole family. Got the adventure bug? The Unesco-listed Teide National Park, with an observatory on top of Spain’s highest mountain, is less than an hour’s drive away.

Kids and adults alike are well cared for at this smart central hotel, which gives you a sense of retreat while being close to all the fun.
Hotels.Strapline: Just metres from golden carpeted beaches

Hotels.Name: Hotel Troya
Hotels.Description:
Stylish and modern, the Hotel Troya is a bright feature packed hotel for families looking to unwind and spend time together on holiday.

With a pool for adults and a pool for children, the environment at Hotel Troya is inviting and friendly. With a play area, a mini club and a disco for children, you can ensure younger guests are well catered for.  For added convenience, the hotel offers 24 hours room service which is handy after a long, luxurious day in the sun.  To help you stay connected, the complementary WiFi is available for you to use at your leisure.

The restaurant at Hotel Troya, The Palapa, offers beautiful views across the lapping seas. With a variety of international dishes and traditional, authentic, local cuisine, you’ll find soulful food full of flavour.

Your holiday at Hotel Troya won’t be all be onsite. The golden beach and rippling tide is a stone’s throw from the hotel. Perch yourself on one of the sunbeds, take a walk along the stunning coastline or build a substantial sandcastle, you’ll enjoy watching the world go by.

At the Hotel Troya, you’ll find all the facilities for either a family or a couple to enjoy a relaxing break in the Tenerife sunshine.

Please note: this hotel does not accept stag/hen parties or similar groups.
Hotels.Strapline: Relax and unwind at Hotel Troya

Hotels.Name: Playa Olid Apartments
Hotels.Description:
Get ready for an unforgettable stay in Playa Olid, filled with ways for you and your family to have an enjoyable holiday in the sun. Home to three outdoor pools, including a kids’ splash pool, recline poolside in the luscious green gardens or have a paddle in the refreshing waters. There are also several sun terraces for you to bask in the sunshine from the comfort of a lounger. Perfect for the whole family, the hotel has a kids’ club and teen club full of ways to keep younger members of the family entertained. Work on your ping pong skills, play some darts and, for video game lovers, the hotel also has a PlayStation.

The studios and apartments give you and the family the freedom of your own living space. Equipped with a kitchenette, it provides all you need for a relaxing stay. As well as that, you can eat in the hotel’s buffet-style restaurant.

If you're craving the feeling of sand between your toes, grab your swimming costume and make for the nearby beach, which is about 15 minutes' walk away. Perfect for swimming, building sandcastles, and relaxing in the sunshine, you might just spend your whole trip down by the shore. It makes a great place to watch the sunset from, too. 

Not much of a beach baby? Why not check out Europe's largest water park, which is just five minutes' drive from the hotel, or make the most of the nearby golf courses and marina – there's something to suit everyone here.
Hotels.Strapline: Holiday as a family in Tenerife

Hotels.Name: Tagoro Hotel
Hotels.Description:
Tagoro Hotel could be the perfect spot for that big family sun holiday you’ve been dreaming of. Within 20 minutes’ walk of both the beach and nearby water park Aqualand, there’s plenty here to keep big and little kids alike well entertained.

While the little ones blow off steam in their dedicated splash zone, you can chill out by the main pool on a comfy sunbed. The kids’ club here is sure to be a big hit, too. With activities ranging from karaoke, painting, quizzes, and bowling, they’ll be kept busy while you relax for a few hours. You can hit the gym, take part in the daytime entertainment by the pool, or maybe even finally finish that book.

If you can tear yourself away from that sun lounger, you’ll find the hotel puts on a generous spread in the buffet restaurant for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Cool off during the day with a cocktail from the poolside bar or head inside to Las Cañadas bar for a relaxed drink before you call it a night.

Hotels.Name: Parque Santiago III
Hotels.Description:
The Parque Santiago III comes with a great selection of facilities – we’re talking a huge, lake-style saltwater pool, a kids' splash park with water jets and sprinklers, and an impressive five restaurants. You’ll have the choice of all sorts of food, including Asian, Italian and international cuisine.

You’ll find it just across the road from Playa del Camisón, which comes with caramel-coloured sands and turquoise waters. The complex has scored a spot on the seafront promenade that heads towards Los Cristianos, so there are plenty of shops, bars and restaurants to try. Popular waterpark, Siam Park, is also just a 10-minute cab ride away – if you can tear yourself away from your poolside sun lounger!

The apartments and studios are bright and spacious, decorated in the traditional Canarian style with wooden furniture, neutral fabrics and the odd pop of colour by way of accessories. They all come with a living area, a kitchenette for cooking your own meals, a private bathroom and a balcony or terrace.

Hotels.Name: GF Isabel
Hotels.Description:
Fun for the whole family, this aparthotel is bursting to the seams with ways for you and your family to have a fun-filled holiday in the Tenerife sun.

The charming Canarian-style complex makes for a great backdrop to hours of fun. Right within the hotel’s grounds you’ll have access to two glistening outdoor heated pools lined with loungers for you to lay back and switch off in the stunning sunshine. If you are more of a beach person, the nearest beach is just a short walk away. Little ones can enjoy the separate kids’ pool featuring water slides. Never a dull moment, the hotel staff are on hand with daily activities that are sure to please the whole family.

For the adults, perhaps you are looking for something else such as hiring a bike and exploring the local areas. You are also close to plentiful shops, restaurants, cafés and bars to discover in the local area. Either way, at the end of each day, you can retreat to your own private bungalow, apartment, or villa, flaunting views over the pools, the gardens, the mountains or the sea.

You’ll feel right at home with the fantastic amenities and spacious accommodation. You’ll be able to make lovingly prepared meals in your own kitchen which you can enjoy in the living space. If you fancy a night off cooking, the hotel has a buffet-style restaurant. No matter how you choose to fill your time here, you are sure to have a holiday to remember.

Hotels.Name: Landmar Costa Los Gigantes
Hotels.Description:
The Landmar Costa Los Gigantes has got it spot on when it comes to location. You’ll find it perched in peaceful spot that’s within a 10-minute stroll of one of Tenerife’s famous black sand beaches. And because it’s on a hill, you’ll have fantastic views of the iconic Los Gigantes cliffs, as well as the island of La Gomera, which sits just across the Atlantic.

There are plenty of places to soak up the sun during the day, including a huge lagoon-style pool and a quieter pool edged by Bali beds. Little ones, meanwhile, will be kept busy at the kids’ pool and in the splash park. You’ll find another pool in the spa, as well as a sauna, a hot tub and plunge pools. It’s one of the best spas in the area and offers a lengthy list of pampering treatments, making it the perfect place to unwind. Not your style? Up the tempo by going to the gym for a workout.

The daytime activity programme will entice you away from your sun lounger with everything from tennis and beach volleyball to ping pong and mini-golf. And there’s a hotel-run kids’ club and teens’ club to make sure that youngsters are never at a loose end, and they'll absolutely love the club mascot, Landi. They've not forgotten about the under-four crowd, either. From Thursday to Monday little ones aged between six months and four years are welcomed at the baby club, which you'll need to reserve your spot for at least 24 hours in advance (and attracts an hourly charge). 

Then there’s the high ropes course – quite possibly the star of the show – where you’ll get harnessed up before making your way through the assault course. It’s not just for kids either – anyone over the age of six can try it out. Plus, families with younger guests between 6 and 15 years old are welcome to use the spa during the daily morning sessions – who said pampering was just for grown ups? 

Feeling peckish? Take your pick from one of the two restaurants, where you can enjoy buffet-style show cooking, themed nights, Italian classics, barbequed specialities, and more. There's also three onsite snack bars for when you're craving a light bite, and four bars to enjoy a delicious afternoon aperitif or nightcap.
